verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence close to this story is dbt Projects on Snowflake, which claims to 'orchestrate' transformations inside Snowflake. That implies recurring job execution but never documents a schedule. Snowpipe is event-driven continuous loading, explicitly an alternative to running COPY on a schedule, so it is not a recurring scheduler, and the community mentions of daily automations describe user-side arrangements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native recurring scheduler (cron/interval tasks), multi-step workflow/DAG scheduling, schedule management via CLI/API for AI agents, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: dbt Projects on Snowflake brings the full dbt lifecycle into Snowflake: develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe your transformations in the same place your data already lives.
